checks_actual_results: Execution context passed before implementation. Existing Flow execution/history, FoundationControlService and RuntimeDataService were reused; no duplicate CRUD path, workflow engine, backend, frontend or Redis was added.

The designer exposes field update and data create/update through Chinese module, operation, target source, title source, target field, fixed/business-field value and failure-policy controls. Users enter no JSON, internal action code, field code or physical record ID.

Publication rejected a legacy custom action code, duplicate assignments, a wrong typed fixed value and a node-result reference that was not earlier on the execution path. Published versions froze module version and field identity/type/dictionary/reference bindings.

UPDATE_FIELD updated an actual bound record through the common executor. A DATA_ACTION CREATE followed immediately by UPDATE of that prior node result completed in one advance; its only record ended at version 1 with expected typed values.

Every committed automatic write produced exactly one completed core idempotency record and one reliable outbox row. Flow start replay returned the same instance and did not increment the updated record version or create another record.
A runtime NUMBER variable containing text was rejected by server field validation before a business row or false common-action success was committed; the Flow entered a visible recoverable incident.

The same unexamine-golden-backend container was restarted after completed and failed instances were persisted. Business records, automatic-action history, idempotency/outbox results and the open incident remained readable.

Ordinary designer GUI showed the two data nodes and structured selectors. The unified runtime GUI showed completion plus two readable new/update history items with module name, record number and field count, without field values.

Cleanup terminated the failure instance, logically deleted records 228 and 229, disabled only flows 157-163 under the random fixture prefix, restored Module51 active-record count to 4, preserved module version 94 and left zero pending tasks/jobs/active executions.

JDK21 focused policy tests and Maven package passed. Frontend vue-tsc/Vite production build passed with only the pre-existing bundle-size warning. Targeted git diff --check passed with CRLF normalization warnings only.
